description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LDAPTestService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains various unit tests to verify LDAP connection behaviors, handling of invalid credentials, server contact issues, and configuration setup.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the LDAPTestService functionalities, including connection validation, error handling for invalid credentials and server contact issues, using PHPUnit framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment before each test, ensuring server configuration is loaded once.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, disables anonymous binding, sets server page size, and loads fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests a valid LDAP connection with admin credentials.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests an LDAP connection without bind credentials, expecting a failure due to unauthenticated access.

methods.name: testInvalidUserName
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with an invalid user name, expecting invalid credentials exception.

methods.name: testInvalidUserNameSyntax
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with an improperly formatted DN, expecting a syntax error.

methods.name: testInvalidPassword
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with an invalid password, expecting an invalid credentials exception.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection to a non-contactable host, expecting a contact exception.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection on an incorrect port, expecting a contact exception.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption on a standard port, expecting a contact failure.
